steps.say: First, setup runs and connects to room A.
When a dependency changes, cleanup runs first with the old values, then setup runs with the new ones.
And when the component is removed, cleanup runs one last time.

slides.text: Before every re-run, and once on unmount: setup and cleanup always come in pairs.
slides.say: The takeaway: cleanup runs before the Effect runs again, and once when the component goes away.
